evidence_class: PRE-REGISTRATION (hypotheses only; none run, none scored, no slot used)
scope_note: Ranked, untried fault-zone hypotheses. Tested families already in the repository are excluded: H57-H (bend/scarp relative strike), H57-I2 (two-host relay), H57-J (slip-sense transition), the orientation ablations, and the dot-budget sweep. Each entry records its blocker. Nothing here is a score, a forecast, or authorization to build or submit.
validation_rule: Test the top-ranked hypothesis only on the spatially blocked holdout (HOLDOUT-DTI, buffered whole-component LOQO, 153 physical 20 km clusters, paired draws). Require a strictly positive paired 95% lower bound against the matched control. Reject on any canary AUC > 0.90 or on any uniqueness firing. No slot may be used on a result that has not cleared both.

ranked.hypothesis: Catalogue-proximity pruning helps only where a dot is redundant with the training catalogue. Removing dots within 2 px of the TRAINING catalogue, at a matched dot count, raises HOLDOUT-DTI more than removing an equal number of random dots.
ranked.why_ranked_first: The one measured mechanism in this repository: the owner-reported 0.2778 file is a nested subset of 0.2708 with 2,545 dots removed, all 1.4 to 2.0 px from the mapped catalogue (evidence/session6_mechanism_and_witness.json). This is file-level only. It has not been tested on a holdout.
ranked.predicted_direction: positive paired difference versus matched random pruning
ranked.falsifier: Paired 95% lower bound for (proximity-prune minus random-prune) is at or below 0, or a canary fires.
ranked.leakage_control: Catalogue used for pruning is the training-fold catalogue only; held-out catalogue never referenced.
ranked.blocker: IR-S6-05: training_features.tif is absent and the feature link is unreachable from this sandbox. Holdout cannot run.

ranked.hypothesis: Fault-tip termination anatomy: the signed along-strike distance to visible segment tips, compared with matched mid-wall controls, adds held-out skill beyond distance-to-fault.
ranked.why_ranked_second: Named as a 'Future test' in docs/research/hypotheses.md (section 2, fault-tip relay/termination). No implementation or holdout result exists in the repository. Mechanism is bidirectional: tips can be growth sites or arrest sites.
ranked.predicted_direction: positive paired difference versus distance-only control, on both sides of the fault
ranked.falsifier: Leakage canary fires, or results depend on one side of the fault only, or the paired lower bound is at or below 0.
ranked.leakage_control: Tip distance computed from visible vectors only; tips inside held-out components are not used.

ranked.hypothesis: Flight-line-aligned magnetic mimic suppression: linear magnetic-gradient responses that are parallel to flight-line direction and lack a matching geological edge are down-weighted; this improves held-out precision over an unsuppressed magnetic-edge feature.
ranked.why_ranked_third: Mimic risk is named in REMAINING_WORK.md (flight-line leveling residuals, magnetic contacts). No suppression test exists. Ranked below H6-1 and H6-2 because it needs a magnetic input that is not present in data/official, and survey spacing is coarser than the pixel size.
ranked.predicted_direction: positive paired difference versus unsuppressed magnetic-edge feature
ranked.falsifier: Suppression removes true-fault signal (held-out recall drops) or the paired lower bound is at or below 0.
ranked.leakage_control: Flight-line direction taken from survey metadata, not from fault labels.
ranked.blocker: Magnetic survey raster and flight-line metadata are not in data/official. IR-S6-05 also applies.

ranked.hypothesis: A binarised registry-compatible surface (each soft raster thresholded to its declared dot budget) lets the uniqueness rule be applied to soft predictions without changing the 0.70 limit.
ranked.why_ranked_last: This is a protocol question, not a geology hypothesis. It can only be decided by the owner (IR-S6-01 option B). Its effect on the 0.70 gate is untested. It is recorded so the owner can rule on it.
ranked.predicted_direction: lowers worst forward overlap below 0.70 on the 696-raster index
ranked.falsifier: Overlap stays at or above 0.70 for the witness, or the change alters the verdict on owner-scored rasters (IR-S6-02).
ranked.blocker: Owner ruling required before any candidate is built (IR-S6-01).
